title: PSX Design Round 5: Single Column and Clean Surfaces
scope: Compare door_flush walls with two source-texture candidates: a clean floor and single aligned column, then the same treatment with a lower ceiling and square corner trim. The Gaussian PLY, route, and collision remain fixed.
review_prompt: Check that the added column cover reads as the existing single column. Compare the clean floor and ceiling-wall corners, and note any remaining Gaussian artifacts or loss of the Backrooms character.
